આમુખઃ

રાજયમાં વેગથી થઈ રહેલ સર્વાગી વિકાસ, વાયબ્રન્ટ ગુજરાતના માધ્યમથી
દેશ તેમજ વિદેશના રોકાણકારો દ્વારા ઔધોગીક વિકાસ માટે થઈ રહેલ રોકાણ,
ગ્રીન એનર્જી તેમજ વૈકલ્પીક ઉર્જા તેમજ કૃષિ ક્ષેત્રે સંશોધન માટે થઈ રહેલ રોકાણ
કરતી દેશ-વિદેશની કંપનીઓ પોતાની કોર્પોરેટ/રજિસ્ટર્ડ ઓફીસ રાજયમાં શરૂ
કરે અને રાજયની આવકમાં નોંધપાત્ર વધારો થાય. તેમજ રાજયમાં રોકાણ કરેલ
દેશ-વિદેશની કંપનીઓને પ્રોત્સાહન મળે અને વધુ દેશ-વિદેશની કંપનીઓ
રાજયમાં રોકાણ કરવા પ્રોત્સાહીત થાય અને જમીનનો મહતમ ઉપયોગ થાય તે
હૈતુસર દેશ-વિદેશની કંપનીઓની કોર્પોરેટ/રજિસ્ટર્ડ ઓફીસના બિલ્ડીંગ માટે
હાલ અમલી “હોટેલ એન્ડ મીક્ષ યુઝ ડેવલપમેન્ટ વિનિયમો-૨૦૧૬” માં
કોર્પોરેટ/રજિસ્ટર્ડ ઓફીસના બિલ્ડીંગને લગતી ચોકક્સ જોગવાઈઓને સામેલ કરી
કોર્પોરેટ ઓફીસ, હોટેલ એન્ડ મીક્ષ યુઝ ડેવલોપમેન્ટ આપવા માટેના વિશિષ્ઠ
નિયમો તૈયાર કરવાની બાબત સરકારશ્રીની વિચારણા હેઠળ હતી. સબબ
સરકારશ્રીની પુખ્ત વિચારણાના અંતે “Regulations for Corporate Office,
Hotel & Mixed Used Development-2024” ઘડીને અમલ કરવા આથી
હુકમ કરવામાં આવે છે.

** હુકમ 2.

આથી ગુજરાત નગર રચના અને શહેરી વિકાસ અધિનિયમ, ૧૯૭૬ ની કલમ-
૧૨૨ ની પેટા કલમ (૧) હેઠળ મળેલ સત્તાની રૂએ રાજ્ય સરકાર દ્વારા આ સાથે
સામેલ "Regulations for Corporate Office, Hotel & Mixed Used
Development-2024" ને મંજુર કરેલ છે અને તેનો અમલ તા. ૦૬.૦૯.૨૦૨૪
થી કરવા આથી હુકમ કરવામાં આવે છે. અગાઉ તા.૦૧.૦૨.૨૦૧૬ ના હુકમ

REGULATIONS FOR CORPORATE OFFICE, HOTEL &

MIXED-USE DEVELOPMENT-2024

1. SHORT TITLE, EXTENT AND COMMENCEMENT

1.1

1.2

1.3

These regulations may be called "Regulations for Corporate Office,
Hotel & Mixed-Use Development-2024."

These regulations shall be applicable within the jurisdiction of the
appropriate authority constituted under Gujarat Town Planning &
Urban Development Act, 1976.

It shall come into force from 06.09.2024.

2. APPLICABILITY

These regulations shall apply to any building for the Corporate
Office, Hotel and Mixed-Use buildings proposed under these
regulations.

3. DEFINITION

3.1 "Act" means the Gujarat Town Planning & Urban Development Act
1976.

૩.2 "Appropriate Authority" means authority as defined under Act.

3.3 "Competent Authority" means authority as defined under CGDCR.

3.4 "Developer" means and includes an owner/ person/ persons/
registered society/ association/ firm/ company/ joint ventures/
institution/ trusts entitled to make an application to develop any
project under these regulations.

3.5 "Escape routes" means any well-ventilated corridor, staircase or
other circulation space, or any combination of the same having, 2.50
mts. minimum width, designed for the purpose of evacuation and by
means of which, the occupants can reach to safe place in the open
air at ground level.

3.6 "Fire escape stairways and routes" means escape routes designed
and placed as advised and approved by the fire officer.

3.7 "Fire Officer" means the Chief Fire Officer of the Municipal

Corporation or the Regional Fire Officer of the concerned Fire
Region.

"CGDCR" means the prevalent Comprehensive General Development
Control Regulations as applicable for the relevant appropriate
authority.

"Guest Drop off Canopy" means the canopy at the main entrance.

"Corporate Office” means any building or a group of buildings of a
single Public Limited Company wherein 100 % built up area is being
used for administrative activities intended to support the running of
their principal business fulfilling the conditions as prescribed in
regulation No.8. Such Building may or may not be the registered
office of the said Public Limited Company.

"Heritage Hotel" means a hotel run in a fort, fortress, palace, haveli,
castle, hunting lodge or residence with heritage features, built prior
to January 1950 and approved by the Ministry of Tourism,
Government of India. Such Heritage Hotels should also obtain
necessary category certification from the competent authority.

"Hotel & Mixed-Use Development" means any building or group of
buildings of Hotel under single management with the minimum 50%
of the total built-up area of plot used for the Hotel as a main activity
and other allied activities like, recreation, entertainment, resorts,
retail, shopping for tourist, service apartment/ apartment hotel,
leisure activities and attached food services. The rest of the built-up
area can be used for other purposes like commercial, mall, multiplex,
convention Centre, etc.

"Refuge Area" means an area designed and provided at various
levels or floors in the building as per requirements in National
Building Code of India - 2016 (NBC), to hold occupants during a fire
or any other emergency.

"Service Floor" means a floor, which shall be buffer to take care of
structural transit, laying and looping of the service lines and other
service purposes only.

"Atrium (plural atria)" means a large open space, generally to give
the building a feeling of space and light, often several stories high
and having a soft roofing / glazed roof and/ or roofing of any
material for safety from weather, but not to give a space / support
for any activity to be carried above it.

"Global FSI" means a FSI permissible under these regulations
irrespective of the zone.

"Zone" means the zone as designated in the prevalent sanctioned
development plan of the appropriate authority.

The words not defined in this regulation shall have the meaning as
defined in the Act, the Gujarat Town Planning and Urban
Development Rules, 1979 and CGDCR as amended from time to time.

4. DUTIES OF THE COMPETENT AUTHORITY:

For the purpose of these regulations, the competent authority shall;

may recommend to the government to allow the benefits available
under any scheme of the state or central government;

ensure all necessary NOCs / Clearances from relevant Govt.
Department, as required, are submitted before issue of
development permission.

5. PROCEDURE FOR SECURING THE PERMISSION

5.1

5.2

Subject to the provisions of these regulations and the CGDCR, any
developer intending to develop under these regulations, apply to the
competent authority under section 27 of the Act, along with the
required documents and shall forward copy to the State
Government.

With regard to procedure to be followed, the manner of making
application, the documents to be submitted along with the
applications, the protocols of drawings to be submitted, etc. unless
otherwise prescribed, the provisions of CGDCR shall apply mutatis
mutandis.

6. PLANNING PROVISIONS

6.1

6.2

6.3

The minimum area of building unit shall be 3500 sq.mt. abutting on
road having width of 30 mts. or more. (Except in the case of heritage
hotel where such restrictions shall not apply)

For the purpose of these regulations, irrespective of the Floor Space
Index (FSI) prescribed in any zone, it shall be regulated as under:

Total FSI permitted on any plot shall be the sum of the Global FSI and
Premium FSI where...
- Global FSI (GFSI) shall be...

whichever is minimum;
- Premium FSI shall be permitted at rate of 40% of the jantry;
- In case of Corporate office Premium FSI shall not exceed 0.70
in any case.

The built up area of following shall be excluded from the
computation of the FSI:
૦ Basement and other floors used for the parking;

Margins and Built-up area:

Notwithstanding anything contained in CGDCR, margins
shall be regulated as under:

a.

A minimum clear margin of 9.0 mt. in all sides shall be
provided. However, for Corporate Office building
having height up to 16.50 mt. minimum clear margin as
per prevailing CGDCR shall be provided.

Nothing except cabin and structures related to security
may be permitted in the margins;

Height of building:

Height higher than that permitted under the CGDCR shall be
known as additional height. The Additional height (AH) shall
be regulated as under:

a.

Up to 70 mt. height shall be permitted on road width 30
mt. or more;

more than 70 mt. height shall be permitted on road
width 40 mt. or more.

Access for cyclists, pedestrians, physically challenged

and public utility vehicles shall be designed for their safety

Access Points onto public roads should be located and

On each floor minimum of one service corridor of minimum

Lifts - planning and design

The planning and design of lifts shall be in accordance with
NBC.

Uses permissible in Basement:

Space for services, which may include electric cabin,
substation, A.C. plant room, Generator room, boiler room,
hotel laundry, housekeeping, stores, lockers and rest room
for the reserve staff. However, such services shall only be
permitted on first level of basement. Such uses shall strictly
be ancillary to the principal use.

Even after approval under these regulations, permissions from

for EIA clearance, NOC of Fire Department and all other relevant

The structural safety of the building shall be the responsibility of the

Government order dated.11.12.14 No.NRY-142013-5116-L.

Deduction as decided by the competent authority shall be applicable
in case where the plots are not the part of the Town Planning
Scheme area.

8. CONDITIONS FOR CORPORATE OFFICE

The Developer of a Corporate Office, shall submit a notarized
undertaking on Rs.300/- stamp paper at the time of making application
under these regulations stating that —

a) This Corporate Office of the Company is the only one proposed
under these regulations within the jurisdiction of .................
Urban / Area Development Authority.

(If required, in the same Development Authority, the Company
may develop their other Corporate Office or offices or the
Registered Office as per the provision of CGDCR in force) ;

b) Company has paid up share capital of not less than Rs.50
crores;

c) The company has invested in the state of Gujarat more than
Rs.100 crores in the industrial sector in last 5 years;

d) All the buildings within the building unit shall always be used
for the official purpose of the Company. No part of building
shall ever be used and/or leased and/or leave and license
and/or sold to any other organization/ company/ person or
persons for any purpose whatsoever;

e) Building or buildings shall not include or be intended to include
any area where any type of commercial use, storage,
manufacturing, sale, distribution and supply or such other
similar activities / services are carried out;

f) Transfer by sale or lease or otherwise of the said premises to
any other entity including its own subsidiaries/ group
companies/ associated companies/ affiliated companies shall
not be done without prior approval of the Competent
Authority.

9. GRANT / REFUSAL OF THE PERMISSION:

9.1

9.2

9.3

The State Government may on receipt of the recommendation from
the Competent Authority grant the principal approval to the
proposal with or without conditions or refuse the proposal.

Validity and lapse of the permission shall be according to section 32
of the Act.

Development to be carried out in one year from the issue of the
development permission or the issuance NA order, whichever is

earlier.
